notes.title: First Dread Templar Patch Is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Templars,

Dread Templar's full version has been out for almost two weeks now and it's time for the first patch! We have addressed many of the issues you've pointed out and we will keep doing so! For now, read the patch notes and let us know how you like the game by writing a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/reviews/][b]review[/b][/url]. Also if you find anything else in the game you'd like to report, feel free to start a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/discussions/]discussion[/url] here on Steam.

P.S.: Yes, we heard you and removed that annoying jumping sound effect.

[h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3]

[b]Bugs / Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue of an incorrect stat in E4M1: the max secrets amount should be 8.
[*] Fixed an issue where a blood gem was not displayed correctly in E3M5, you can now find it before the boss fight.
[*] Fixed an issue that the super secret could be activated directly in E5M2.
[*] Fixed an issue that 2 health packs were blocked by an invisible wall in E4M4.
[/list]

[b]Music/SFX:[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced the incorrect music in E4M2.
[*] Fixed an issue of the character's jumping sound effect.
[/list]

[b]Performance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved display issues in E5M2, E5M3.
[/list]

[b]Runes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Golden rune "Roar" obtained in E4M6's super secret and its description is now displayed correctly.
[*] Adjusted ammo consumption when using the golden rune "Roar".
[*] The silver rune "Inferno Gauntlets Expansion III" can now be found in a secret place in E5M1.
[*] The silver rune "Trap Launcher Expansion III" can now be found in a secret place in E4M5.
[/list] 

[b]Additional Functions:[/b]
[list]
[*] F11: Fast switching between default / HUD off / All UI off.
[/list]

Thank you for your attention! Now go ahead and follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing][b]Social Media[/b][/url] so you never miss anything important about Dread Templar.

notes.title: DREAD TEMPLAR IS OUT OF EARLY ACCESS NOW
notes.content:
Templars!

The time has finally come and we are incredibly thrilled to announce that the full version of Dread Templar is [b]OUT NOW[/b]!

One of the most anticipated retro-shooters of the year has finally left the Early Access stage and is ready to be served straight to your computers in its full glory. Take the dangerous journey through hell, fight off 20+ enemy types, 9 bosses, search every nook and cranny for secrets and side areas and upgrade your weapons and skills in over 100 different ways!

[b]Dread Templar - Full Launch Trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=PhcyDAZLQac;full][/previewyoutube]

The Early Access was a beautiful journey full of adventure, an amazing community has grown around the game and we are really grateful that you can finally experience everything Dread Templar has to offer. You are always welcome to join our [url=https://discord.gg/fulqrumpublishing]Discord[/url] and [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] to talk about the game and share your most epic plays! Also if you have anything to ask or want to share your opinion on Dread Templar, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/reviews/]reviews[/url] are always open to you!

[h3][b]Now, let's step into HELL together.[/b][/h3]


[h3][b]Full Release Content:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] E4 and E5
[*] New weapon
[*] New bosses
[*] New enemies
[*] New puzzles
[*] New emblems/skills
[*] New SoundFX/Music
[*] Full localization (English, French, German, Spanish, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Brazillian Portuguese and Russian)
[*] Fixes and rebalancing
[/list]

notes.title: Dread Templar's Content Update 0.971 brings the Guardian Mode!
notes.content:
Hello Templars!

Dread Templar is on a roll again! This time he needs to protect a blue crystal and survive as long as possible. This special mode is called a Guardian Mode and below you can find all the information you might need along with the trailer:

[previewyoutube=Ouallhj6HL0;full][/previewyoutube]

 
[h2][b]Guardian Mode[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/3d4b25ca5c1dad00d5c83c333a566f316ad13b1e.jpg[/img]

Guardian Mode is a wave based, endless game mode. Protect the blue crystal in the center of the scene as long as you can! The rules are simple, if the blue crystal is destroyed or if you die, you lose.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/3151f564421c657378628a40bb12ae26da08a4bc.png[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/1e1cc91cbb7f0213d584fb6a3745a821aa58e9fc.jpg[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3]Hints:[/h3]
1. Your weapon upgrades, Blood Gems and Emblems obtained in Campaign Mode can be used in the same difficulty in the Guardian Mode.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/9463c3672ed98cfc7492289c640dae8e3c231812.png[/img]

2. Get points by killing demons and finishing a wave.

3. Purchasing power-ups and supplies can help against the demons coming out of the teleportation points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/bc56bf0cf16f3a973e574aa9ff898dd1f941a01a.png[/img]
  
<Red> Greatly increase the damage of all weapons
<Yellow> Summon a defender fight for you, defender will attack any enemy approaches the blue crystal.
<Green> Recover player's HP.
<Blue> Restores the durability of the blue crystal

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/b75a0c672c4f32397429538da9750d4eb0280f24.png[/img]


Let us know how you like the Guardian Mode and share your best scores! A perfect place to do so is our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FulqrumPublishing]Discord server[/url], so feel free to join!

tags.feature: Guardian Mode is a wave based, endless game mode.

Dread Templar is getting a new glow-up! The newest update brings and option to apply a filter on your screen, so the retro game will feel even more retro! Or not, it's only up to you which filter you're going to choose!

[h2][b]Full changelog:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Pixelate setting:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/84f31e0a714e5583d9a7488be0b383aec45d24f5.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Filter settings:[/b][/h3]
The latest build contains 5 filters on Options>Filter>Filters, the above mentioned pixelate setting affects all the filters except "Green Boy".

[list]
[*] "Green Boy"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/edd2094659bd23a891f51aa256a7489eedcf08d8.png[/img]

[*] "Sin"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/6c297c167c446dfd4ea7131cf26613701eb7350b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/1da9702bdcfd116cdbb33cd4f767c437b43c5dd3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/c6f1d260eff8665674dc722ba7416814d1f49bd3.png[/img]

[*] "Old TV"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/59932778db3b15c663fc29819697440995336541.png[/img]

[h3][b]Controller Support:[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The 6th Content Update for Dread Templar is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Behold, Templars,

It's been a while since our titular Dread Templar finished off his last batch of enemies. Now is the time to hit the road (and many, MANY demonic abominations, of course!) again and progress in his story.
Let us introduce the new Content Update which contains three new levels, one new weapon and three new enemy types and a new, menacing bossfight! Grab your katanas, stock up on ammo and make your way through the hordes of nightmarish foes. Give 'em HELL!

[previewyoutube=wDGqAIPdbCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h2]Dread Templar EA 6# Update 0.9.6 change log:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] 3 new levels

E3M3 World's Edge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/330da6f6ebbb95f01c9c76877116824a5a63a850.png[/img]

E3M4 Distorted Time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/122e296a3a042cf8cc6f19ba2152bb25a657af87.png[/img]

E3M5 The manipulator
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/8dca62e798de915549d078d85c2e73fede4fbebf.png[/img]

[*] 1 boss fight
[*] 3 new enemy variants
[*] 2 side areas
[*] 17+ secrets
[*] 2 super secrets
[*] 4 golden emblems and 8+ silver emblems
[*] 14 monsters SFX
[*] 2 ambient SFX
[*] 1 new weapon "Tri-rocket launcher" - it launches 3 small missiles, each missile will cause explosive damage in a small radius. The emblem "Fire Wasp" allows it to launch homing missiles, further enhancing its efficiency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/efe2319592c8a159a370f7e367577f1e27eff39c.png[/img]

[*] Other adjustments - The level select mode is now using a new logic: After finishing a level, the next level will be shown on the level select panel (previously, players needed to actually start a new level to activate the button for it on the level select panel)
[/list]

[b]There is one apology we have to make [/b]- the original roadmap promised controller support to be implemented in this update. Unfortunately we have run into some issues and were not able to put it in the game in a state we would be comfortable with, and rather than postponing the whole update because of this, we decided to release the actual content and continue our work on this issue, and implement controller support at a later date. We hope you can forgive us, and will keep you posted.

Thank you very much for your ongoing support! If you like the game, leave a review on its Steam page, it helps us a lot. Also, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/1c-entertainment]Discord server[/url] to become a part of our community and receive the freshest news!

notes.title: Dread Templar Content Update #5 is here!
notes.content:
Behold Templars!

The new Dread Templar Content Update brings plenty of useful features that will make slaying monsters much easier! From now on you will always clearly know when you headshot an enemy. Also we managed to fix that annoying „Unarmed Strike“ problem where players were not able to use melee attacks after throwing katanas. Download the new update today to enjoy all of the new features.

[h2]Full Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]New „Hit Marker“ feature[/h3]

As mentioned above, „Hit Marker“ will allow you to see when you deal damage to an enemy and will change color when you perform a headshot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/ac23182ae88ad815ab50456b4ddde80224418d09.png[/img]

[h3]Picking up non key card items[/h3]

The non key card items will be shown on the screen after you pick them up, so you can now clearly understand what you got.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/8f784b6285b596779985a6784cdbeaf0c564ba36.png[/img]

[h3]Side Area stats[/h3]

Level stats and level summary panel now show the "Side Area" stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/85a99d9b324a646807fd91481bc75c319af58d20.png[/img]

[h3]Mouse sensitivity settings improvement[/h3]

Some players in the community requested to be able to enter more decimal places to get a higher precision mouse sensitivity. Now you can press Enter to call out the input field and enter
[i]mouse_sensitivity 0.0000[/i] to adjust this parameter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/6193b78a13d4d9ccd552ed4f45409a420a7d3d1c.png[/img]

[h3]New weapon behaviour[/h3]

"Unarmed Strike" is now available after you throw katanas. For a long time, it has been set to be unable to use melee attacks after throwing the katanas. Players sometimes had to switch their katanas from throwing mode to melee mode. Now, you can finally make unarmed attacks during the cooldown. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/812194003181b13177e67031ca32d8679b93e4a7.gif[/img]

As usually, we yearn to know if you like the changes. Leave the game a review, hit us up in the local discussion or join [url=https://discord.gg/98k7CV5X]our Discord server[/url]!

notes.title: Content update #4 (part 1) is out now!
notes.content:
Greetings Templars!

The new content update has just been released! 

There is somewhat less content in it than we initially planned. When working on all the new levels, enemies and bossfight, we realized we might not make it all on time and release a properly tested update on schedule in December as we originally announced. This is why we've decided to complete the first of the two planned levels, thoroughly test it and polish it and release it as "Part 1" of Content Update 4, rather than risk making you wait for the update as a whole. We are hard at work to get the rest of the promised content very soon.

For now, please enjoy the new level, "Dead Sails", and a short trailer we have prepared:

[previewyoutube=0RcQpDmGYiI;full][/previewyoutube]

New content:
1. New E3M1 level "Dead Sails", including:
[list]
[*] 4 new enemies.
[*] 2 new golden emblems and 4+ silver emblems
[*] 1 side area
[*] 1 super secret
[*] 1 new song
[/list]

How to enter the "Dead Sails" level?
[olist]
[*] If you have finished Chapter 2, E3M1 will be available from the level select menu. 
[*] You can also enter E3M1 normally in the campaign mode from the E2M5's final portal.
[/olist]

2. The Halloween area becomes a super super secret
You can now find your way into the Halloween area through the super secret in E1M1!

3. Some enemy rebalancing and adjustment of the supplies locations.

We also wanted to thank everyone who voted for us in the Indie of the Year 2021 Awards. Thanks to you, Dread Templar made it to the Top 100 and we are now in the finals! With so many excellent indie games being released, this is a huge honor for us. And if you believe the game deserves to be among the fabled Top 10 and want to give us the best Christmas present ever, please go vote for Dread Templar in the Released - First Person Shooter category [url=https://www.indiedb.com/groups/2021-indie-of-the-year-awards/top100]on the voting page[/url]!

This is one of the best ways to show your appreciation for the game and help us out. But we appreciate any other type of feedback just as much - be it a review written here on Steam, a post in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/discussions/]discussions[/url] or coming to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/1c-entertainment]Discord server[/url]. Your participation energizes us and all your suggestions and feedback really, really help us out in making the best game that we can for you, so don't be shy!

notes.title: Dread Templar Content Update #3 Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/b62250186ae2453013410471ce18d3a4c57022fc.jpg[/img]

Hello Templars! 

We've got some great news. The [b]#3 content update[/b] (or as we like to call it, version 0.931b) for [b]Dread Templar[/b] is out. It brings [b]a new Game+ mode[/b] and [b]expanded in-game settings[/b] so that you can customize your playing experience to the fullest. 

Here's what's new: 
[list]
[*] A New Game+ option
[*] New crosshair settings
[*] Damage Indicator settings
[*] Blood Screen settings
[*] Screen Shake While Shooting settings
[/list]

Let's have a closer look at the newly added features: 

[h3]New Game+[/h3]
 
New Game+ (Alpha) is now available in the game. However, the second chapter is not the final chapter of the game, therefore it's likely to undergo some changes with the full release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/9b93bc450bd534739a27bf3ecbf5c903adaad661.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [u]How to activate the New Game+ option?[/u]
[/list]
For the players who have previously completed the game, the toggles for NG+ will be activated on the New Campaign selection menu.
[list]
[*] [u]What to do in case that the NG+ option doesn't show up?[/u]
[/list]
Just interact with the final portal in E2M5 again. The system will save your data and show the NG+ options now.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/ac3c9e4bcdd419363da3aeaa45d5ed69c2d1d961.png[/img]


[h3]New In-Game Settings:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] New crosshair settings 
[*] A new Damage Indicator option and its customization 
[*] A new Blood Screen option and its customization
[*] A new Screen Shake While Shooting option for a more immersive experience
[/olist]

[b]We'll be happy to hear your thoughts! [/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334730/Dread_Templar/#app_reviews_hash]Leave us a Review[/url] or join us on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/discussions/]Dread Templar Steam forum[/url]. 

Get Dread Templar now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1334730/Dread_Templar/

notes.title: Dread Templar - Halloween event countdown & contest reminder
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/b62250186ae2453013410471ce18d3a4c57022fc.jpg[/img]

Greetings Templars, 

As you all know, Halloween is sadly over. Bummer! But it's not all gone yet! 
In terms of our game's content, the Halloween event is still up and running until [b]Wednesday 10th of November[/b]. Jump in to enjoy the festivities while they still last. 

[b]The doors to the Halloween realm will then be closed, and will re-open again as a Super Secret in one of the upcoming content updates.[/b]  Thanks to your feedback and the love you've shown for the Halloween content, we've decided to make it a permanent addition to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/6d59ac56e6644716194a182317de455ca40e7505.png[/img]

Furthermore, the [u]minigame high score contest[/u] is still ongoing! Take part to claim your place on the upcoming in-game leaderboard. 
Here's how to proceed: 
[list]
[*] Take a screenshot of your achieved high score in the Halloween shooting gallery minigame
[*] Share it on Twitter and include the name you would like to be known in the game as
[*] Tag the account @1C_Company and add the hashtags #DreadTemplar #Halloween #Contest 
[/list]

This Wednesday we will pick 10 highest submitted scores that will be featured on a leaderboard, introduced as an Easter Egg in an upcoming update. Here's your chance to become a part of the game forever.

notes.title: Dread Templar 0.920f Hotfix Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/4349718c588d674dfd811b30b4b524fcca8a2a5f.png[/img]

Good day, Templars!

We've been working on various improvements and today we're bringing you the latest Dread Templar Hotfix. You can look forward to:

[list]
[*] The E1M2 "falling bug" fixed
A bug caused by the last update, which prevented some players from proceeding from E1M1 to E1M2, has been fixed. 

[u][i]Here's how to proceed:[/i] [/u] Please load your E1M1 save data. Take the elevator from E1M1 and you can now go to E1M2 as intended. Please do not load your E1M2 AUTOSAVE directly, the AUTOSAVE is not updating the player's location correctly.

[*] Improvement: Unlock a new level in the Level Select mode
Once you come to a new level in campaign mode, this level will be unlocked in Level Select mode right away (as opposed to previously having to be completed first). 

[*] Halloween... Forever?! 🎃
We've been happy to hear that you guys enjoyed the Halloween special feature, and the feedback requesting it to stay in the game was immense! Sure enough, your wishes have been heard. For now, the Halloween event's features will close, but the full Halloween content will officially become a part of the game as a secret area in the upcoming EA Content Update #4 in December 2021. 
[/list]

Additionally, we have prepared a contest for all owners of Dread Templar - Take a screenshot of your achieved high score in the Halloween shooting gallery minigame, share it on Twitter and include the name you would like to be known in the game as, and the hashtags #DreadTemplar #Halloween #Contest and tag the account https://twitter.com/1C_Company. After the Halloween event ends, we will pick 10 highest submitted scores and they will be featured on a leaderboard in-game, introduced as an Easter Egg in an upcoming update! 

We would also like to take this opportunity to thank you all for your feedback so far. It's given us a chance to smoothen the playing experience for everyone, and we will continue working on that even further.

Halloween is right around the corner and we have prepared a very special update for all players! 

Until November 11, a door close to the elevator at the end of the level in E1M1 is open, and a portal leading to the Halloween side area has been activated. You will face resurrected monsters and their master, Headless Necromancer - can you become their worst nightmare, again?

In the Halloween side area, you can:

[*] Obtain several weapons in advance in E1M1, but they do not come for free - you need to explore the level, find special tokens or win them in a shooting gallery minigame, and exchange them for these weapons.
[*] Face the revenge of the Headless Necromancer - tell it who's the boss here!
[/olist]
Additionally, we have prepared a contest for all owners of Dread Templar - Take a screenshot of your achieved high score in the Halloween shooting gallery minigame, share it on Twitter and include the name you would like to be known in the game as, and the hashtags #DreadTemplar #Halloween #Contest and tag the account https://twitter.com/1C_Company. After the Halloween event ends, we will pick 10 highest submitted scores and they will be featured on a leaderboard in-game, introduced as an Easter Egg in an upcoming update!

Happy Halloween!🎃

notes.title: Dread Templar Content Update #1 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/4349718c588d674dfd811b30b4b524fcca8a2a5f.png[/img]

Greetings templars!

Today we are proud to bring you the very first Content Update for Dread Templar! This update brings in a brand new level statistics screen, rebalancing of the Hell Knight boss fight, SoundFX improvements, save point addition and location adjustment along with numerous other fixes and tweaks that will make the game even more enjoyable.

We would also like to take this opportunity to thank all of our fans who voice their support and / or share their feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1334730/discussions/0/]Steam Forums[/url]. Thank you❤️

Read the full changelog below:

[h3]Boss: Hell Knight (Full Form)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skill "Light Fall" now has a 18 sec cooldown, but the damage is slightly increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/77f9719dc23da3f063e418e6212d74f3ec162c1e.png[/img]
[*] Skill "Black Hole (big)" now has a 10 sec cooldown, but the duration is slightly increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/7f7769018e5d3e99e759e8dff64148c129f23967.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player character now jumps more easily when going down slopes/steps.
[/list]

[h3]Level Improvements:[/h3]
[u][b]Tutorial Level:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the "Air Dash" area - it will now be easier to dash to another platform while mid-air.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't switch back to dual pistols after switching to dual katanas in the tutorial level.
[/list]
[u][b]E2M3 side area:[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/4990f307a8d76e25eca0acbf29284a055aa98ff1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the demons and supplies and adjusted some terrain in the side area of E2M3 - players will now have more room to get through this side area.
[/list]

[h3]Menu and Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level stats display: You will now be able to turn on/off the level stats display by pressing "Tab", or in Settings>Game Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38205272/1a7b37e065858624df45bcf6ef4ef85d3d6624b0.png[/img]

[*] Nightmare difficulty in Level Select mode will be shown once players enter the nightmare portal.
[*] "Previous Weapon" default key has been changed from "Tab" to "Q".
[*] You will now be able to choose to go back to the main menu or continue to the next level after completing a level in the level select mode.
[*] Fixed bug that sometimes caused Black Bow golden emblems unable to be equipped in a skill slot.
[/list]

[h3]SoundFX improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redone the Inferno Rocket launching sound effect.
[*] Added a SFX for character landing on the ground.
[*] Fixed an issue that some area's SFX volume did not follow the set value.
[/list]

[h3]Save Points:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted and added some save points. 
[*] All levels except E1M1 will have a save point at the beginning.
[*] You will now be able to Save/Load a data by double-click on Save/Load panel.
[/list]

[h3]Difficulty adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the Hell difficulty, added a few small health packs, but slightly increased the damage of demons on Hell difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: Dread Templar 0.917f
notes.content:
**Improvements:**
When players open the weapon upgrade panel, game will be paused
Players will exit cutscenes immediately upon taking damage
Added a new option "Mouse Scroll Invert" in Options>Controls
Fixed some level issues

**General Changes:**
**Character:**
Increased the amount of bullet time recharged by killing demons
Increased the duration of the bullet time

**Boss: Spider Queen**
Slightly reduced the damage and attack rate of Spider Queen's summoned creatures
Slightly increased the cooldown for the summon skill of Spider Queen
A marker will be attached to the Spider Queen's summoned creatures, players will now be able to spot them more easily.
